token_policy: No additional experiment token budget or total-token stop. Official API has no unlimited setting. Use its maximum supported output (384K=393216), including reasoning, instead of omitted-parameter max-effort default 128K. A provider limit still exists.
timeout_policy: No overall decision or match wall-time cutoff; 600 s socket inactivity timeout only. API/network failures remain explicit and are not silently retried.
comparison_note: Fresh independent match, not continuation of interrupted history. Same prompt, map, seed, motion skills and observation schema; output/timeout limits deliberately changed. Twenty decisions cover the full 40 s match at 2 s per decision; this is not a token budget. No retries or alternate strategy.
